planned_slices.objective: Characterize current certification promotion and no-artifact escalation behavior.
Tighten certification gate promotion to require explicit evidence for named gates.
Preserve upstream provider failure semantics before parse-fallback escalation.
Align tests with the stricter truth model.
Validate the bounded diff and record proof.

replan_events.summary: Escalation trigger ordering change alone was insufficient because classify_escalation_class still favored schema markers over provider_failure.
replan_events.response: Reordered escalation-class precedence so explicit provider_failure and upstream provider/auth/quota failures classify as provider_transport before parse/schema markers.

replan_events.summary: Doctor-mode certification test initially expected exit_code=0, but the mocked doctor payload intentionally preserved missing promptpack state.
replan_events.response: Kept the doctor-mode test focused on emitted certification truth while asserting the expected non-zero doctor exit.

per_slice_verification.result: Characterization locked current overclaim path and route-attempt parse-first semantics before edits.
Provider probes and artifact-group completeness no longer auto-promote PASS for live-provider or topology gates.
Provider quota failure with no artifacts now records provider_failure on the route attempt and classifies as provider_transport.
Tests now enforce UNKNOWN on weak certification evidence and preserve upstream provider semantics in the negative path.

previous_gate_semantics.live_provider_readiness: Could become PASS from topology_payload.provider_reachability.probes without explicit provider preflight evidence.
previous_gate_semantics.operator_topology_resilience: Could become PASS from required_artifact_groups.required_groups_present_pct >= 100 without explicit topology status evidence.
previous_gate_semantics.overall_status: Could become VERIFIED when those derived gates, artifact completeness, and validator status all passed.

new_gate_semantics.live_provider_readiness: PASS requires explicit provider preflight payload status. Topology probes are recorded as observed evidence only.
new_gate_semantics.operator_topology_resilience: PASS requires explicit topology status from DOCTOR_FULL.json or RUN_DASHBOARD.json. Artifact-group completeness is retained as evidence only.
new_gate_semantics.overall_status: VERIFIED requires every named gate to reach PASS under the stricter evidence rules.

previous_escalation_semantics.route_attempt_trigger: No-artifact failures were labeled parse_failure/parse_failure_no_retry before upstream provider failure truth was considered.
previous_escalation_semantics.route_attempt_class: Even after provider_failure trigger propagation, escalation_class could still collapse to schema_repair because schema markers were checked first.

new_escalation_semantics.route_attempt_trigger: Provider/auth/quota/transport failures are checked first and produce provider_failure before parse-fallback escalation is considered.
new_escalation_semantics.route_attempt_class: provider_failure and upstream provider/auth/quota failures now classify as provider_transport before parse/schema markers.
